integrity: Source first-public date verified from the arXiv v1 submission history, independent of later preprint and journal dates. Claims are stated with explicit quantifiers and a reproducible standalone checker. The self-review does not constitute external verification.
scientific_limitations: The theorem applies to bivariate copulas and each finite p>=1, with unit Lipschitz bounds in the ell-p norm and supremum-norm topology; neither p=infinity nor higher dimensions nor a closed linear subspace of copulas is asserted. Finite computer tests supplement the analytic proof; an unindexed equivalent statement cannot be ruled out.
title: Anchored ordinal sums yield maximal convex spaceability at every finite Lipschitz exponent
